info.title: Foonix API
info.description:
Public REST API for Foonix, served at `/api` on `foonix.net`.

This document is the **source of truth**: server validators, TypeScript
types, the fetch client, and the served OpenAPI document are all generated
from it (see `docs/openapi-plan.md`).

tags.name: reports
tags.description: BYOK probe reports and model availability

get.description: Returns metadata only — never the key or its ciphertext.

post.summary: Add or replace a provider credential
post.description:
Verifies the key against the provider before storing it. The key is
sealed with envelope encryption; only ciphertext is persisted.

get.summary: List the models available to the caller
get.description:
Owner-scoped. By default returns the models the caller's keys have probed
successfully (`scope=availability`) once they have run a report, falling
back to the global catalog before that. `scope=catalog` always returns
the global catalog with the caller's availability merged in.

post.summary: Start a probe report for one of the caller's credentials
post.description:
Probes every model the provider lists, using the caller's stored
(encrypted) credential. Returns `202` immediately; poll
`GET /reports/{id}` for progress and results.

409.description: A report is already running for this user

get.summary: Get a report with its per-model results

delete.summary: Delete a report and its results

post.description:
Proxies to the resolved provider using the caller's stored, encrypted
credential. Supports `gemini`, `groq`, and `nvidia`. Pass `stream: true` for
Server-Sent Events. The response carries `x-byokfree-provider` and
`x-byokfree-model` headers.

200.description: The caller's API keys (no secret material)

post.summary: Create an API key (token returned once)

201.description: Created; the plaintext token is only returned here

get.summary: Get a conversation with its messages

delete.summary: Delete a conversation and its messages

post.summary: Append a message to a conversation
post.description:
Persists a user or assistant turn. Assistant turns carry the
provider/model and performance metadata (TTFT, token usage).

delete.summary: Delete a message and everything after it
delete.description: Used by edit / regenerate to rewind a conversation.

post.summary: Run a completion within a conversation (server-orchestrated)
post.description:
Appends the user turn (unless `regenerate`), replays the conversation
history (oldest turns trimmed to fit the context window), proxies the
provider, and persists the assistant turn with exact usage. Streams SSE
by default (`stream: false` for a single JSON completion).

bearerApiKey.description: Gateway API key (`nbk_…`) sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

x-available.description: Whether the caller's keys probed this model successfully within the recency window

x-last-checked.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the caller's most recent probe of this model
